text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week continues to produce great results, and her reputation has grown. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Two towering walls continue to stand in her way—El Condor Pasa, the Phantom Bird, and Grass Wonder, the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa finally challenges Special Week to battle it out at the Japan Cup!
